findings.current: You can now control qi with great freedom.
findings.defect: General control replaces the specific ability to draw in and release qi.
findings.rationale: 수발 names the receiving and sending of qi, not merely control over it.
findings.replacement: You can now draw in and release qi with great freedom.

findings.current: *I owe him. I owe him a hell of a lot.*
findings.defect: “Him” makes Peng the sole creditor, though the source leaves the debt open and the narration immediately connects the rewards to all the dead.
findings.rationale: The Korean does not specify whom he owes.

findings.current: You have earned the great achievement **Full-Body Makeover**!
findings.defect: “Makeover” loses the achievement name’s plastic-surgery joke.
findings.rationale: 전신성형 literally invokes full-body plastic surgery, a deliberately comic label for his physical transformation.
findings.replacement: You have earned the great achievement **Full-Body Plastic Surgery**!

findings.current: And then, as I slipped into a state of nothingness, a voice faintly echoed in my ear.
findings.defect: “Nothingness” obscures the loss-of-self state described by 무아.
findings.rationale: 무아 refers here to being without awareness of oneself, not to an absence of everything.
findings.replacement: And then, as I slipped into a trance where I lost all sense of self, someone’s words echoed faintly in my ear.
findings.source: 이내 무아(無我)의 세계로 빠져들던 내 귓가로 아스라이 울려 퍼지던 누군가의 한 마디를.

summary: The draft is largely faithful, but it narrows the narrator’s debt to one person and blurs a qi mechanism and two deliberate terms.
